verdict.rationale: Plausible documents official HTTP APIs (Events API for tracking, Stats API for querying stats with API keys) that developers can build against, but there is no evidence of official language-specific SDKs/client libraries, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to support AI-native/agentic tooling discovery. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages (JS/Python/etc.), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt/AI-friendly docs endpoint.
